narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved across parts of northern Illinois during the morning of September 6th producing heavy rain, localized flooding and localized wind damage.
ev: Numerous viaducts and underpasses were flooded across the southern suburbs of Chicago. Rainfall amounts included 2.99 inches in Park Forest and 2.90 inches in Peotone.
lsr: Local media reports numerous viaducts and underpasses flooded across southern suburbs.
